Privacy Policy

Effective Date: July 2026 · Last Updated: 2026

1. Information We Collect

BrowserGames100 does not require account creation to access any games. We collect minimal technical information such as browser type, general geographic region, and aggregate gameplay statistics to optimize performance and server capacity.

2. Cookies & Google Advertising

We partner with third-party advertising vendors, including Google AdSense. Google uses cookies (such as the DoubleClick DART cookie) to serve relevant advertisements based on a user's prior visits to this and other websites across the Internet.

Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google My Ad Center or via the Network Advertising Initiative.

3. GDPR & CCPA Rights

Visitors from the European Economic Area (EEA) and California have rights to access, delete, or restrict processing of their personal data. Contact us at privacy@browsergames100.com to submit any privacy inquiries.
